newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia can not accept 8.0 pct unemployment.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia can not accept 8.0 pct unemployment.

text.p: Australian Treasury Secretary Ted Evans said on Monday that Australia can not accept unemployment rate stuck at 8.0 percent.

"I'm certainly not going to accept a future of unemployment stuck at eight percent. I just don't see that being the case...and it's not something we should accept," Evans told a business luncheon in Sydney.
"We could have a different unemployment level today, but no growth whatsoever, if we had a different relationship there," Evans said in a post-budget speech.
"The challenge for structural policy will be to change those relationships," he said.
"But in part that is what enterprise bargaining is all about, to find a relationship at the enterprise level which will give a better guarantee of employment and better job opportunities," he added.
In July Australia's unemployment rate stood at 8.5 percent.
